children: Canada logistics software firm's fiscal Q2 revenue up 12% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 beat analyst expectations
Diluted EPS for fiscal Q2 rose 33% yr/yr to $0.57
Descartes did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year
SERVICES REVENUE GROWTH - Services revenue, which comprised 94% of total revenue, rose 13% yr/yr, supporting overall revenue growth
RESTRUCTURING BASE EFFECT - YoY gains in operating income, net income and cash flow were amplified because the prior-year Q2FY26 was depressed by the fiscal 2026 restructuring plan
OPERATING LEVERAGE – Income from operations rose 36% to $65.5 mln as gross profit increased $18.5 mln while operating expenses rose $1.2 mln, aided by lower other charges
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
The stock recently traded at 29 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 30 three months ago
